[Antojāla+ī+kata] (ti) CL=9 Another method: antojāla+kata. ī is inserted. Another method: a is changed into ī.
See the insertion of 'ī(cī)' paccaya at Mog,4.119. Rū,ṭī.315. Bālāvatāra.266. In Nīti,sutta.1338, it is said that ivaṇa is inserted. Herein, if i is inserted, there becomes antojālikatā. Antojālassāti antojālaṃ, antojāle katāti antojālīkatā. Dī,ṭī,1.186.] (1) caused to be/exist in the net. (2)(a) caused to be in the net of discourse. (b) though not made to be included in the net of Desanā by way of the inclusion of the subject matter, it is made to included in the net of Desanā by way of the inclusion of view dependent upon that subject matter. Though it is not made to exist in the net of Desanā by way of the inclusion of the subject matter, it is made to exist in the net of Desanā by way of the inclusion of view dependent upon that subject matter; one.
